description: SQL Server TDS encryption and EPA/CBT calibration profile.

states.name: encrypt_off_no_auth_validation
states.why: SQL Server reported ENCRYPT_OFF and authenticate validation was not performed.
limitations: No authenticate-stage response was captured; EPA/CBT state cannot be promoted.

states.name: encrypt_on_expected_login_failure_with_cbt
states.why: TDS-wrapped TLS and CBT evidence were available, but SQL Server only returned ordinary login failure semantics.
limitations: Ordinary login failure does not distinguish EPA disabled from EPA accept when CBT is present.

states.name: encrypt_required_epa_binding_signal
states.why: SQL Server response contains EPA/CBT-related indicators under encrypted TDS.
limitations: SQL Server version and provider behavior must be calibrated because error wording can vary.

states.name: encrypt_not_supported_cbt_unavailable
states.why: SQL Server reported encryption not supported, so TLS CBT evidence is unavailable.
limitations: EPA/CBT state cannot be promoted when SQL Server does not provide TDS-wrapped TLS evidence.
